name: DDC Input Switcher
author: PropSuite
description: Visually configure and toggle monitor input sources using DDC/CI.

barWidget.description: Open a visual panel to configure and toggle monitor input sources.

schema.label: DDC display
schema.description: Display number from ddcutil, or auto for the first detected display.

schema.label: Source A
schema.description: First monitor input in the toggle pair.

schema.label: Source B
schema.description: Second monitor input in the toggle pair.

schema.label: Toggle hotkey
schema.description: Global shortcut used to toggle the configured source pair.
